newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL- Ikon slips on co Q3 views.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL- Ikon slips on co Q3 views.

text.p: Ikon Office Solutions took a slide in after-hours trading Thursday after saying it expected transformation costs of up to $22 million in the third quarter, and earnings per share in a range between $0.30 and $0.32 before the cost.
According to First Call estimates, analysts' consensus for the company's third quarter earnings was, $0.40
Traders said Ikon traded at 27-1/2 after the bell, down 4-1/2 from an unofficial close of 32.
In addition, the office products distributor anticipated fourth quarter transformation costs of $20 to $25 million.
"I don't see anything else, that's the big one," a trader said.

Gateway 2000 Inc did not trade after regular hours although the personal computer company reported that it had agreed to acquire Advanced Logic in a deal valued at $194 million. Advanced Login, for its part, remained halted.
In regular trading, the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 58 points to reach an unofficial close of 7777.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 5,300 on Thursday, down from 72,700 the previous day, while session two volume hit 263,319, above Wednesday's 180,000.
AMEX reported that 25,900 shares were traded after-hours compared with none Wednesday.
